finding: Qwen3-VL's official implementation/research surface explicitly targets visual agents, computer-use grounding, OCR, spatial perception, video understanding and controllable visual token budgets. These capabilities support researching Retina as active temporal/control fabric around native VLM perception instead of duplicating semantic recognition modules.
why_interesting_for_target_architecture: It opens a denser architecture question: which historical Retina OCR/object/grounding functions can be causally replaced by native model capabilities while preserving temporal continuity, provenance, active sensing and action verification outside model authority.
falsifier: Frank-specific matched experiments show standalone Retina semantic modules materially outperform native-Qwen paths under the same resource and recovery constraints.
